campaigns.name: Document & verification sprint
campaigns.goal: SPA, Radiant statement, DARI certificate, NOC policy, exact size/floor/view in hand

tasks.t: Request statement of account + resale/NOC policy from Radiant
Download interim registration certificate from DARI
Confirm exact sqft, floor, view, parking from SPA floor plan
Fill unit details into data/property.json and the calculator

campaigns.name: Broker shortlist & co-broke offer
campaigns.goal: 3 approved brokers briefed; 1 exclusive or 2 non-exclusive listing agreements signed

tasks.t: Approve outreach to top-scored brokers in the Approvals tab
Ask each broker: buyers who enquired on their 3BR, achieved prices, marketing plan
Choose listing broker(s); sign listing agreement with permit

campaigns.name: Portal launch (PF / Bayut / Dubizzle)
campaigns.goal: Listing live with real photos/floor plan; 15+ enquiries, 5+ qualified

tasks.t: Approve final English + Arabic advert copy
Provide floor plan, SPA extract, payment schedule to broker

campaigns.name: Investor networks & social
campaigns.goal: Posts approved and published by owner; inbound investor contacts logged

tasks.t: Owner joins 3-5 Abu Dhabi property investor groups (manual)
Approve and post Facebook copy (owner posts manually)
Approve LinkedIn messages to 10 ADGM/real-estate professionals

campaigns.name: Day-30 / Day-60 price review
campaigns.goal: Price decision based on enquiries, viewings and competing listings

tasks.t: Day 30: fewer than 5 qualified enquiries -> step down one price band
Day 60: no written offer -> reprice to market median ask

milestones.label: Latest comfortable date for a signed MOU
Hard deadline for MOU (NOC + DARI transfer need lead time)
Portal-listed expected completion (handover payment falls due)
